cli.stdout:
name: cq-rec-ws
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: /Users/aryangarg/Personal/apps/codequest/.cq-rec-ws
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    environment:
      DATA_DIR: /notes
      GREETING: Hello from Compose
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - -qO-
        - http://localhost:8080/healthz
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 3
    image: cq/webapp:compose
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 8080
        published: "8097"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: notes
        target: /notes
        volume: {}
  front:
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 80
        published: "8098"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/aryangarg/Personal/apps/codequest/.cq-rec-ws/proxy
        target: /etc/nginx/conf.d
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
networks:
  default:
    name: cq-rec-ws_default
volumes:
  notes:
    name: cq-rec-ws_notes
